copy.bend-partial-return-help: Source returns its ratio and starting phase. Depth returns only the index. The bend mode, inspected instant, gold point and kept bend stay put; neither button plays a note.

returnsource.message: returnsource preserves unrelated state and answers its supplied native experiment

copy.bend-carrier-gap-help: Compare sine values at the same gold point. The difference is signed and belongs to this frozen moment; it is not a difference in loudness. Moving the point stays silent.

carriergap.message: carriergap preserves unrelated state and answers its supplied native experiment

copy.bend-gap-point-help: Move the gold point to the earliest largest difference among the plotted samples. Neither wave nor the kept bend changes. This is a sampled difference, not the greatest continuous gap or a loudness comparison.

gapinspect.message: gapinspect preserves unrelated state and answers its supplied native experiment
